title: Revision phase result (paper team, revision-plan.md)
description: Validates the structured result object the revision phase returns alongside its revision-plan.md artifact, which carries both the point-by-point response table and the complete revised manuscript that supersedes draft.md. artifactPath must equal the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml (the core's runtime enforces the same exact match); responses are required so every comment from the three reviews is answered on the record, and declined comments stay visible to the human final gate.

artifactPath.description: Exactly the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml; the runtime writes the reply body there and rejects any other value.

summary.description: Structured Chinese summary of the revision: how many comments were adopted, partially adopted, or declined per review, and what the unresolved disagreements are.

responses.description: One entry per comment from the three reviews; empty only when all three reviews returned no comments.

supersedes.description: The previous draft this revision replaces; the artifact carries the complete revised manuscript, not a patch.

citations.description: Optional: citation keys carried into the revised manuscript, reusing the draft's keys; one entry per key whose claims changed in the revision.

openQuestions.description: The unresolved disagreements (declined or partially adopted comments with their reasons) and any items the human final gate must decide; mirrors the artifact's remaining-disagreements section. Empty only when every comment was adopted and nothing needs the gate's attention.

commentRef.description: The comment id as numbered by the reviewer, e.g. "M1", "S3", "W2".

review.description: Which review the commented artifact came from.

disposition.description: The writer's disposition; declined and partially-adopted responses carry the disagreement the human final gate adjudicates.

response.description: What was changed and where in the revised manuscript, or the full reason for declining; a declined reason must be strong enough for the human gate to adjudicate.

appliedTo.description: The revised manuscript section the change landed in; expected for adopted and partially-adopted responses.

ref.description: Citation key exactly as it appears in the revised manuscript, e.g. "[1]", "[Vaswani2017]", or an experiment id like "[E1]".

claim.description: The claim this source supports after the revision.

source.description: Identifying string of the cited work as available from the reviewed materials (title, authors, year, venue or URL), or the experiment id in experiments.md when the claim is experiment-grounded.

retractionChecked.description: True only when this work's retraction status was actually verified upstream; unverifiable status stays false.
